Hermeneutics

Methods and principles for biblical interpretation and exposition

This is the controversial topic where authors "tell you" how you should interpret the Bible. (And here, all along, I thought that was the job of the Holy Spirit!) On the bright side, exegetical hermeneutics invites us to explore original-intent - and that is a core provision of Berean Bible College: research tools.
